meta.name: drowned_atlantean_city
meta.prompt: A drowned Atlantean city half risen from a tropical lagoon: prismarine colonnades, a monumental tide gate over the channel, a leaning bronze colossus waist-deep in the water, pearl divers' huts on stilts, coral gardens, and a moon pool at the heart of the palace.

params.brief: A monumental weathered bronze colossus leaning at a perilous tilt, standing waist-deep in the lagoon channel. Formed of green-oxidized copper blocks, cut copper stairs, exposed grating, and sea lantern accents, one arm raised toward the open sea.

A grand ceremonial colonnade of fluted prismarine and dark prismarine pillars lining the submerged processional approach, topped with water-worn entablatures, submerged braziers, and glowing sea lanterns.
